finalText:
Build clean, 0 errors, exit 0. Rest = 8 deprecation/lint warnings, harmless noise.

Two real bugs from bump fixed:
- `src/core/options.js`: `resolveRetries` read `options.retries` — bundler now sends `retryCount`. Crashed on `.toFixed` of `undefined`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: `isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flag — new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.
